props.label: Setup Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to setup the work center for this product.

props.label: Prod Operators
props.description: The number of operators required to use the work center for production.

props.label: Standard Duration per Unit
props.description: Standard duration is the amount of time required to produce 1 unit of output.

props.label: Ideal Duration per Unit
props.description: Ideal duration is the amount of time to produce 1 unit of output, at ideal OEE rate.

props.label: Cycle Duration
props.description: cycle time in seconds per unit of production (actual machine cycle)

props.label: Setup Duration
props.description: Time required to perform a setup for this process, regardless of the production batch size.

props.label: Process Duration (Fixed)
props.description: Process duration - the fixed amount of time required to perform this process, also used for OSP lead time.

props.label: Delay After
props.description: Fixed time required before starting the next process.

props.label: Delay Before
props.description: Transit time required before beginning this process.

props.label: Durations
props.description: seconds per unit of production at standard.

props.label: Order
props.description: The sequence of the work order step - helps to drive sequencial manufacturing processes. Allows for reordering of steps - provided that the work order has not yet been started.

props.label: Remaining Quantity
props.description: The sequence of the work order step - helps to drive sequencial manufacturing processes. Allows for reordering of steps - provided that the work order has not yet been started.
Total quantity required to complete distribution

props.label: Unit Per Cycle
props.description: (Int!, Required, Default: 1): Number of units produced per machine cycle - pulled from approved workunit if it exists, or workunit - otherwise, defaulted to 1
